purpose: 月3倍の機会数不足を、既存entryのパラメータ調整ではなく独立したprice-action/structure戦略族で埋められるか検証する。

truth_boundary.entry: signal uses only completed M5 bar i; fill at next consecutive M5 OANDA ask open for LONG or bid open for SHORT
truth_boundary.exit: fixed completed-bar horizon; LONG exits at OANDA bid open, SHORT at ask open
truth_boundary.slippage: primary uses additional 0.5 times contemporaneous spread adversely at both entry and exit; zero is diagnostic only
truth_boundary.fee: 0 under the frozen account observation; no extra fee invented
truth_boundary.financing: trades crossing 21:00 UTC daily financing boundary are excluded because causal schedule is unavailable
truth_boundary.currency: JPY quote pairs only, so PnL JPY equals price difference times units
truth_boundary.overlap: one open trade per pair/family/parameter set; later signals wait until the fixed exit
truth_boundary.gaps: lookback, entry, and exit require exact consecutive 5-minute timestamps; no fill-forward

time_split.holdout: UNREAD_AND_UNUSED; streaming reader stops before parsing the first row at or after this timestamp
time_split.split: for each window ending at holdout_start, first 60% TRAIN, then 1h embargo, remainder VALIDATION

families.BREAKOUT_CONTINUATION: close breaks prior lookback high/low with SMA20/SMA50 alignment
families.LIQUIDITY_SWEEP_REVERSAL: wick breaks prior high/low but completed close returns inside
families.RANGE_REVERSION: completed close in outer 15% of prior range with trend efficiency <=0.30
families.COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT: prior 6-bar range <=35% of broader range and completed close breaks the compression with SMA alignment
families.SMA_PULLBACK_CONTINUATION: SMA20/SMA50 trend and completed close recrosses SMA20 after a one-bar pullback

train_gate.connected_plateau: at least one adjacent lookback or horizon point in the same family/pair/session also passes

validation_gate.multiple_windows: sign must be positive in 32d and 64d when both have eligible samples
